issues.description: Meal constructor signature is inconsistent with the specification: the problem statement/UML requires `Meal(String name, String[] ingredients)` (name first), but the template defines `Meal(String[] ingredients, String name)` (ingredients first). Students following the specification (and the commented Main example) will get compilation errors with the template API.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template constructor to `public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients)` and update the assignments accordingly (keeping Main/example calls as `new Meal(name, ingredients)` to match the problem statement).

issues.description: Specification contradicts itself about whether `SealSaloon.stock` is instance-level or static: it first states SealSaloon has a `final Stock stock` (implying per-instance field), but later explicitly requires `stock` to be static (shared across instances). This ambiguity can cause students to implement the wrong field modifier combination and fail tests expecting shared stock.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the wording consistent by explicitly specifying `private static final Stock stock` (shared across all SealSaloon instances) and remove/adjust the earlier text that suggests an instance-level `final Stock stock`.
